recognize_zh: 視野中散布多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells），合併標靶細胞、船形細胞、小球形與大小不一的紅血球；在 HbS 與 HbD 雙重異合子（HbSD）的家族背景下，這種有鐮刀化的嚴重異形紅血球即為臨床上類似鐮刀型貧血的表現。
features: Numerous sickled (drepanocytic) red cells with pointed ends, some crescent or boomerang-shaped
Boat-shaped/oat cells and elongated irreversibly sickled forms
Target cells and scattered dense, hyperchromic microspherocyte-like cells
Marked anisocytosis with microcytes and larger oval macrocytes
Occasional red cell fragments; scattered platelets in background; no nucleated cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous sickled red cells, including crescentic and boat-shaped forms, together with target cells, dense microspherocytic cells, ovalocytes and larger macrocytic red cells. Platelets are present in the background and no nucleated red cells or leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a sickling hemoglobinopathy; in this family study, the appearance fits compound heterozygous HbS/HbD-Punjab disease, which behaves clinically like sickle cell anemia.

ddx.vs: HbSS has an identical smear, so the distinction requires HPLC showing a single S-window peak without the additional D-window peak seen in HbSD.
HbSC shows fewer sickle cells but more target cells and angular HbC crystal-containing 'billiard ball' or 'Washington monument' cells, with HbC migrating in the C/E/A2 region.
S/beta-thal shows more pronounced microcytosis and hypochromia with elevated HbA2 and variable HbA on HPLC rather than a D-window variant.
Elliptocytes are blunt-ended ovals of uniform shape without pointed tips, and drying artifacts are oriented in one direction across the field.
